verdict.rationale: Sill does run host and viewer on different operating systems: macOS is the host and iPhone/iPad is the viewer, connecting over Wi-Fi, USB, direct wireless or remote access. Coverage is limited to Apple's ecosystem, though. There is only a Mac host and an iOS/iPadOS viewer, with no evidence of a desktop viewer client or support for Windows, Linux or Android. Missing for 10: desktop viewer clients, Windows/Linux host or client, Android client, cross-vendor OS pairings.
